themes: US solar and storage names are re-rating on falling rate expectations and IRA implementation clarity, creating durable upside for inverter and residential installers through 2025.

sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US-listed solar/energy storage names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) and Indonesia EV/battery plays (VKTR, TOBA) on strength; sector breadth is healthy with normal signals and US leadership. sectors.ai: Buy consumer staples on the ALERT signal: Indonesia's FMCG upcycle is broadening beyond staples into mid-cap processors (BRRC, COIN, JARR) as rural wage growth and Ramadan restocking drive volume. Rotate into palm-linked consumer names (BWPT, PGUN) for margin leverage, but trim pure-play discretionary (EL, FOLK) on valuation.
